preserved_failures.note: Both SGD arms fail the pre-registered 1e-4 trajectory/parameter bound. The registered claim that plain SGD is "reproducible by construction" was too strong and is NOT rewritten. The Adam control diverges far more (0.0632 parameter) and was pre-registered as reported-not-asserted.

what_did_reproduce.note: Every arm's trained functional outcome (train and held-out mean CE and argmax) reproduces to 2-5e-8 even though the parameter vectors differ, so the delivered head and its measured behaviour are reproducible; only the parameter path is not.

mechanism_confirmed.explanation: At the float32 rounding floor the gradient sign agrees between float32 and float64 only 0.4978 of the time, i.e. at chance. A normalised (Adam) update is a function of that sign, so a sign flip moves a coordinate by a full +/-lr (measured 0.00257 across arithmetics). An SGD update is proportional to |g|, so the same flip moves it by lr*|g| (measured 3.89e-08), but the divergence still accumulates in proportion to lr, the number of steps and the gradient resolution, and an unstable arm (lr=0.086, oscillating train CE) amplifies it to 0.674.

generalisation_finding.reading: Training CE falls substantially for the two arms that actually optimise (sgd_conservative 1.2509->0.2172, adam 1.2509->0.2344) while held-out CE RISES (1.3735->1.8231 and 1.3735->1.5245). Held-out argmax rises only from 2/9 to 4-5/9 on nine states, which is not evidence of transfer. The head-only action-matching update over frozen latents therefore memorises the 20 training states rather than learning a transferable scoring function, and its held-out calibration gets worse. The primary sgd_matched arm lowers both CEs but its train trajectory oscillates (0.989->1.135) and never converges, so its held-out change is not attributable to successful optimisation.
generalisation_finding.full_candidate_metric_not_usable: full_candidate_argmax_correct is 0 everywhere because the grid holds 25 customers x 30 positions and the global argmax need not fall on the designated customer; it must not be read as an action-match statistic.
generalisation_finding.consequence: The route "train a head on already sealed latents of the pretrained_initial arm" is closed as a path to online gain. Any delivery learning claim needs the backbone and real training data (scientific family 3 after all registered barriers), not more head-only work on these 30 sealed states.

derived_criterion_for_future_stages: Reproducibility of an optimizer trajectory must be stated relative to the float32 arithmetic floor (lr, step count and gradient resolution), not as bit-equality; functional-outcome equality is the criterion this stage actually supports.
